method: Static original application/resource review plus offline original-x86 callback/decoder execution in Unicorn; no original Windows process, physical equipment, network, or guest memory changes
observed_context_provenance: Supervising agent reports retry23 closed warning and UDP resumed; menu action24 blocked43; menu remained dim; regensvc25 did not restore menus. These observations are not generated by this static analysis.

recovery_code.effect: Display main, dim whole menu bar, set HOLD_THREAD1, show retry popup; does not rearm curtain_not_open
recovery_code.successful_effect: Reopen UDP, perform identity/init sequence, clear HOLD_THREAD; no direct menu undim
recovery_code.status1085_effect: Calls open_curtain only when curtain_not_open is nonzero, then sets it to0
recovery_code.curtain_flag_application_references: Recovered application code only reads and clears this flag in the1085 decoder; no reconnect rearm found
recovery_code.regensvc_effect: SetAccessLevel1 changes GUI visibility/size/colors and service access; no menu undim, no open_curtain, no queued device command
recovery_code.conclusion: A reconnect after the curtain flag was cleared can leave menus dim despite resumed responses. This is a static application-logic defect consistent with reported UI behavior; current guest flag was not measured in this review.

safe_application_exit.main_panel_callback: MainCallBack only handles key event7; no EVENT_CLOSE11 action in application code
safe_application_exit.reviewed_input: One guarded WM_SYSCOMMAND SC_CLOSE to the exact original main window; ordinary system Close dispatches the configured close control commit. No Escape, forced process termination, hidden control coordinate click, parameter or simulator changes.
safe_application_exit.runtime_verification_limit: Resource attributes were previously recovered from native CVI runtime. This review does not itself send SC_CLOSE to a live process; actual exit result must be logged separately.
